instruction: Set up a split-screen view where the left half shows files from workspace1.code-workspace and the right half shows files from workspace2.code-workspace, both active at the same time.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because a VSCode window can only have one active workspace at a time. While you can split the editor into multiple panes, all panes must belong to the same workspace context. You cannot have different workspace contexts (with different settings, extensions, and folder structures) active in different parts of the same window.

llm_judge_reasons: Task correctly marked as infeasible with appropriate reasoning
VSCode architectural limitation correctly identified - cannot have multiple workspace contexts active in same window simultaneously
Evaluator uses infeasible() function which is appropriate for tasks that cannot be completed by design
No verification logic needed since task completion is technically impossible
